standard_prerequisites.name: Strictly standard implies smooth after inverting the element
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the two strict-standard equations into a left inverse of the conormal differential.

standard_prerequisites.name: Localization of the naive cotangent complex
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes smoothness of R -> A_a from the NL criterion.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finding a strictly standard element at a smooth point
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the reverse inclusion H_{A/R} contained in H_e.

core_obligations: For a strictly standard element a: the two defining equations give generators of (I/I^2)_a and a left inverse of the differential, hence smoothness of R -> A_a by the NL criterion; so a lies in H_{A/R}.
By definition, and by the inclusion just proved, the radicals satisfy H_e contained in H_s contained in H_{A/R}.
The reverse inclusion H_{A/R} contained in H_e follows from the find-strictly-standard lemma applied at every prime of H_{A/R}.
proof_roadmap: Strict-standard to smooth direction; radical inclusions; reverse inclusion via the construction lemma.
difficulty_reason: A two-direction radical computation; the substantive step is the NL left-inverse argument for a strictly standard element.
